T: Believe in Santa. Believe in dinner.
D: A department store Santa claims he is the real thing, and a court case decides it.
P: Serve the snacks after the Thanksgiving parade.
S: Warm cinnamon sugar donuts, a sweet street snack for a cold parade morning in New York.
Iced Christmas cookies, the treats handed out in the line to see Santa. Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour and chill.
M: Roast turkey with mashed potatoes and gravy, the Thanksgiving dinner after the parade. Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes.
W: Spiced pumpkin pie with whipped cream. Steam and mash 500g pumpkin. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk and cinnamon.
K: Warm spiced apple juice with cinnamon. Heat 1.2L apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks for 15 minutes without boiling.

s.how: Fry 12 frozen donut rings or balls of 500g pizza dough at 175C until golden. Toss while hot in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.
Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour and chill. Roll, cut and bake at 170C for 12 minutes, then ice.

m.how: Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with butter. Make gravy from the pan juices and powder.

w.how: Steam and mash 500g pumpkin. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk and cinnamon. Pour into a pastry case and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

d.how: Heat 1.2L apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into mugs. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
